decision.explanation: The sources identify three distinct entities named '94 Squadron' with different formation years: 1) The Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) squadron formed in 1945 (D1S6, D2S4); 2) The Royal Air Force (RAF) squadron formed in 1917 (D3S5, D5S4); and 3) The US Navy Fighter Squadron 94 (VF-94) established in 1952 (D6S4). The years 1939, 1950, and 1960 found in the source text (D4S2) represent subsequent activations or re-formations of the RAF squadron, not the initial formation of the entity itself, and are therefore excluded as primary formation dates for the distinct referents.
